svg.title: Mem0: facts in a vector store
svg.desc: Mem0's architecture, with the running example. Writing: after each session, an LLM call extracts short standalone facts, seeing the related facts already stored, and only adds. Memory: a vector store of nine facts; the old and the new diet are both kept. Reading: a similarity search embeds the question and returns all nine facts, which go into the prompt; the answer covers every constraint.
